text:
olivia: Heads up — BrightLayer disputed Feb invoice citing ~37% higher usage than their logs. Can we triage?

billing-bot: Invoice 2026-02-15 for BrightLayer flagged via customer dispute; ticket FIN-4821 created.

samir: Can you attach a diff sample and traces? ping eng-ml / eng-platform if we need reprocess.

olivia: Uploaded a quick CSV excerpt showing token_count spikes starting 2026-02-01.
```
request_id,timestamp,model,token_count
abc123,2026-02-01T12:05:23Z,redwood-llama-70b,520
def456,2026-02-01T12:06:02Z,redwood-llama-70b,680
ghi789,2026-02-01T12:07:10Z,redwood-llama-70b,510
```
Customer notes they rolled SDK v2.1.0 the morning of 2026-02-01.

emily: I dug into the SDK change — v2's streaming encoder emits explicit whitespace tokens for prefix normalization. That increases token_count for short prompts by ~25–35% depending on padding. Not a billing bug per se but a counting semantic change.

grant: We can reprocess raw request telemetry and reapply the legacy counting heuristic. Estimate: 6–9 hours job, ~ $400 compute. We'll need to cap retries and verify idempotency.

olivia: Customer is asking for retro credit for Feb/Mar. Using legacy counts my quick calc shows ~$12,340 credit. SQL I ran:
```
SELECT customer_id, SUM(tokens_legacy - tokens_v2) AS token_delta
FROM token_counts
WHERE customer_id = 'brightlayer' AND timestamp >= '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```

samir: @grant ok to run the reprocess job? Need final compute estimate and run window. @olivia can you confirm GL code for the one-time credit?

grant: Approved to run tonight under cost cap $500. I'll start a dry-run on a 10k-sample first. @emily please validate sample mapping.

emily: I'll validate the sample. Plan: if the percent delta <=5% we abort full run; if >5% we proceed and produce per-invoice adjustments.

samir: @sophia can you approve a one-time credit up to $15k for BrightLayer pending results? We'll attach the audit and customer comms.

sophia: Approved up to $15k. Please include a short apology and notes about SDK semantic change. :+1:

olivia: Thanks — I'll draft the credit memo and create invoice adjustment PR. Creating follow-up ticket FIN-4821-BACKFILL. Will post results when job completes.

billing-bot: Scheduled reprocess job reprocess_tokens_job_4821 to start 2026-03-01T02:00:00Z. Dry-run queued.
